# IndianExamInfo
> India's most comprehensive exam information portal — government jobs, entrance exams, board & university results.

## About
IndianExamInfo (indianexaminfo.com) is operated by IndianExamInfo Media Pvt Ltd, New Delhi.
IndianExamInfo summarises recruitment, exam and admission information for readers. Where a page has
been checked against the official notification, the page links to that notification. Pages marked
"not yet verified" have not been checked against an official source and may contain errors; readers
should always confirm dates, eligibility and fees on the official website before applying or paying
any fee.
This site is NOT affiliated with UPSC, SSC, IBPS, NTA, CBSE, or any government body.

## Key Sections

### Sarkari Naukri (/sarkari-naukri)
Government job recruitment notifications for UPSC, SSC, Banking (IBPS/SBI/RBI), Railways (RRB), 
Defence (Agniveer), Police, State PSC, Teaching (CTET), Technical PSUs and more.
Covers: notification, application, admit card, result, answer key, syllabus, cutoff, previous papers.

### Entrance Exam (/admission)
College admission entrance exam updates for Engineering (JEE Main/Advanced), Medical (NEET UG/PG),
Law (CLAT), Management (CAT/XAT), Design (NIFT/NATA), Agriculture (ICAR), Teaching (BEd) and more.

### Board & University (/board-exam)
Board exam results, date sheets and admit cards for CBSE (Class 10 & 12), ICSE, NIOS,
all 29 state boards (UP Board, Bihar Board, RBSE, MPBSE, etc.), and 50+ universities
including MJPRU, CSJMU, BHU, AMU, DU SOL, IGNOU, Patna University and more.

### Blog & News (/blog)
Original articles covering education news, exam preparation guides, career guidance,
scholarships, study abroad, EdTech, and student life. Written by domain expert authors.

## Content Hub Pages
- /admit-card — All exam admit cards, aggregated & filterable
- /results    — All exam results, aggregated & filterable
- /answer-key — Official answer keys with objection window details
- /syllabus   — Complete syllabi with PDF downloads
- /date-sheet — Exam timetables for boards and universities
- /mock-test  — Free online practice tests
- /previous-papers — Year-wise solved papers
- /study-material  — Free notes and PDFs

## Data Freshness
- Admit card and result pages: updated every 15–30 minutes via ISR
- Answer key pages: updated every 1 hour
- Notification/application pages: updated every 2 hours
- Syllabus/previous papers: updated daily
- Blog articles: updated within 1 hour of publication

## Content Policy
- Pages summarise recruitment, exam and admission information; where a page has been checked against
  the official notification, it links to that notification
- Pages marked "not yet verified" have not been checked against an official source and may contain
  errors — confirm dates, eligibility and fees on the official website before applying or paying any fee
- Errors are corrected as quickly as possible once confirmed; report them via the "Report an error"
  link on the page, the Contact page (/contact) or contact@indianexaminfo.com
- This portal does not charge students for any information
